observations.fact: RFP released 2026-09-04; mandatory Zoom bidder conference 2026-10-21 10:00 PT; proposals due 2026-12-04 13:00 PT; conference preregistration requested by close of business 2026-10-20.

Task-order scope includes development, maintenance, ERP/CRM/CMS, data integration/engineering, modernization, cloud/hybrid, low-code automation, AI/ML/generative AI/NLP/computer vision/intelligent document processing/predictive analytics, subject to security/privacy/accessibility/records/data-governance/responsible-AI controls.

Testing scope includes functional/regression/integration/performance/accessibility/API/mobile/security and AI-system evaluation covering accuracy, reliability, bias, explainability, prompt-injection resistance and data leakage.

At least three comparable projects completed in the last five years are required; across them at least one public/regulatory project, one >=$100,000 or >=12 months, and one using a named core platform/technology; client-verifiable references are required.
Evaluation weights are 20 understanding, 20 technical/management approach, 20 contractor qualifications, 10 similar experience and 30 cost; technical qualification threshold is 56 of 70.
South Coast AQMD may select more than one proposer.
Work is defined by individual task order and the actual contract amount is not determined in advance.
